title: Location access is enforced: the report never includes data from a location the user cannot access
permissions_required: One administrator account and one non-administrator account assigned to only some locations.
preconditions: 1. The organization has at least two locations, each with invoices in the chosen date range (seed ZZAUTOTEST data if needed).
2. A non-administrator test user is assigned to only ONE of the locations.
3. An administrator account is also available.
steps: 1. Sign in as the administrator, open the report, and open the location filter — note the locations listed.
2. Sign in as the non-administrator, open the report, and open the location filter — note the locations listed.
3. As the non-administrator, attempt to request a location you are not assigned to (for example by editing the page link if the location is carried there, or any other means available).
expected: 1. The administrator's filter lists every location in the organization.
2. The non-administrator's filter lists only the locations assigned to them.
3. A requested location the user does not have access to is ignored — the report does NOT widen to the whole organization.
4. The report data never includes invoices from a location the user does not have access to.
design_ref: none - SPEC-ONLY (Report Suite has no designs yet)
spec_ref: specs/sbc-sales-by-customer.md Story 4 S4-R7; S4-R8; S4-R9; S4-N1
notes: How an inaccessible location could be 'requested' is not pinned by the spec — probe via the page link / restored saved view at VIU; the pass condition is that it is ignored, never widened.
